messages.author: 7e01961f1f4ce874
messages.subject: Running RMR scripts via oozie
parts:
Hi All,

We are using oozie shell action to execute our R/RMR scripts in our non secured/kerberized cluster. But this has a problem, in non secured cluster shell action executes the script from user which started tasktracker (which is generally mapred) and not by user who started workflow (as mentioned here - http://blog.cloudera.com/blog/2013/03/how-to-use-oozie-shell-and-java-actions/). This forces us to allow mapred user to edit in our directories which is not very clean solution.

I want know your opinions and experiences with oozie and RMR. Is there any thing like R oozie action exist ?

Thanks 
Abhishek
